title: Push draft updates: typed mention scope in payload
description:
Update draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00.md to carry broadcast-scope mention information in the push payload.

Blocked on jmap-chat-spec-fig9.2 (main draft must define wire format first).

Current state (push draft lines 177-180):
- `hasMention` (Boolean): true if account owner's ChatContact.id appears in mentions
- `hasMentionAll` (Boolean): true if message was sent with Space-wide mention scope

Per Decision 6 in jmap-chat-spec-fig9.1, this likely changes to either per-scope flags or a typed scopes array.

Likely scope:
- Replace or augment `hasMention`/`hasMentionAll` per Decision 6
- Update server-side computation of these fields (especially `@here` recipient resolution at delivery time)
- Update push urgency mapping if per-scope urgency is part of the design
- Update IANA-style examples in the push draft

Cross-document consistency: the field names in the push draft MUST match the field names introduced in the main draft (jmap-chat-spec-fig9.2).
acceptance_criteria:
- Push payload fields updated per Decision 6
- Field names match main draft (jmap-chat-spec-fig9.2)
- Urgency mapping (if applicable) documented
- Examples updated to show broadcast mention payloads
close_reason: Replaced hasMentionAll with per-recipient mentionScopes String[] in ChatMessageEntry. Dual-path computation (Message.broadcastMentions OR rich-body 'broadcast' spans), filtered to scopes for which the owner is in the receiving server's local recipient set. mentionUrgency trigger updated; default and required-support property sets updated; example updated and a second variant added showing mentionScopes:['here']. Chat push platform guide will follow under fig9.5.
